steps.content: In order to investigate who's behind the Mania weapon production, you have arranged to interrogate a person of interest. The moment you enter the interrogation room, you hear a commotion—

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content:
"Quick, grab him!" "The chains, the chains!"
"Look out, he bites!" "It hurts! You punk, I'll knock you one!"
The guards are piling at the door with chains in hand. Their target is a young man...
... who was leaping about, jumping and dodging around the interrogation room.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Tie him up!
Your voice is immediately drowned out in the chaotic interrogation room. No one has noticed your presence.
What are you...

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Sinner S-076! Return to your seat!

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: I have a name! Don't order me around like that!
The young man shows extreme anger and rushes at a guard, fists flying.
The guard dodges to the side, putting you right in Wolverine's line of sight.
He is clearly distracted for a moment. He tries to turn his fist, but it's already too late—

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Chief? When did you get here! Are you... alright?
Just a bloody nose. As for you all, what are you doing here?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: We were preparing for interrogation, Chief.
This is the interrogation room, not a place for roughhousing. Go to the training room if you want to fight.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: We were not roughhousing, Chief.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Sinner S-076 is particularly difficult to control. We were afraid he would hurt you during the interrogation, so we wanted to chain him up to keep him from rampaging.

options: He's not dangerous, you just got him upset.

choices.text: He's not dangerous, you just got him upset.

steps.content: Just now, when he saw me, he didn't mean to attack me. It was only an accident. If he was attacking and fighting back against you, he definitely had a reason.
Right, Wolverine?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: You're different...
What?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Nothing! They started it!
Wolverine glares indignantly at the chains the guards are holding.
He doesn't want to be chained up and doesn't want you ordering him around by his serial number, so let's take it down a notch. He didn't hurt me on purpose.
Right, Wolverine?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: You're different...
What?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Nothing! What are you here for, are you going to tie me up too?
I've got a case here. I want to ask you about it.
If I have the guards take away the chains and leave here, with just us two in the interrogation room, will you return to your seat and let me ask you some questions?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Give your word?
Of course.
The guards retreat one by one, taking the wounded with them, and the door to the interrogation room is closed again.
There is a rustling sound, and a black and white furball pokes its head out from under Wolverine's cloak.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content:
This is Pippy. He was scared just now. No need to worry about him.
You may just ask what you want to ask.
I'll get straight to it, then.
You provided raw materials for making Mania weapons to gangsters, right?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: No.
But a gang member testified that it was you who provided them with Corruptor remains. How do you explain that?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: ...Comes from me.
You denied providing them with raw materials for weapons and then admitted that you offered them Corruptor remains. You don't see a contradiction there?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: I told you, I only gave the monsters to them. I don't know anything about any weapons.
How could you not know what the Corruptor remains would be used for?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: I'm just a hunter. I didn't need to know that.
As a hunter along The Rust, you should know better than anyone how dangerous Corruptors are. You gave such dangerous things to someone else without even asking what they were to do with it?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: What the hell business was it of mine...
You try to keep calm and convince yourself not to treat this wild kid like normal.
Corruptor remains are what Mania weapons are made out of.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: So?
So what you did benefited the production of Mania weapons, which have been circulating in Syndicate and taken many innocent people's lives!
Putting on an impatient face, he clearly has not yet realized the severity of his crimes.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: I don't know anybody from that Syndicate. What does this have to do with me? People die every day.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: I trade monsters with the gang for meat, because when I have meat, I can get by. I don't know what those gang guys were doing with them, and I'm not interested.

steps.speaker: Pippy
steps.content: Rawr!
Pippy matched his expression and nodded deeply, apparently in complete agreement with his master's "meat theory."
You feel you couldn't dig out anything from him but "meat."
But the investigation can't stop here. You can only hope you can get some clues from Wolverine about the unknown mastermind behind Mania weapon production.
When you were talking about the gang, it sounded like they were not strangers to you?

options: How do gangsters find you to make a trade?
Are you pretty familiar with "those guys"?

choices.text: How do gangsters find you to make a trade?
Are you pretty familiar with "those guys"?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: We've met before.
Are you friends?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Hmph, friends...
Wolverine grits his teeth and lets out a sneer.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Would you train a friend like a dog?
Wolverine grits his teeth and lets out a sneer.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Yes, I am... Very familiar.
He grits his teeth and lets out a sneer.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: They trained me like a dog every day. Of course I'm "familiar" with them.
Trained? So you've been in contact for a long time with the gangsters we suspect of making Mania weapons?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Yeah, they started doing this a long time ago. Back then, I was still in the gang, helping them fight Corruptors.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content:
Then I wasn't there anymore, and they couldn't fight Corruptors, so they came to me for help again.
Hmph, worthless trash...
That is to say, the Mania weapon supply chain started long before you knew about it... This is valid new information.
So can you tell me, specifically, what the people on this list have done?
test
test
test
test
test
test

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: This one—
He points at the first picture.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: He's the dog trainer who taught me how to track. He forced me to memorize the map of the Rust.
He flips through the files and points at the next picture.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: This guy didn't let me eat at the table! He'd just throw a plate on the floor. And if I didn't catch a Corruptor, I wouldn't get any meat.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: This guy would take me out on a leash to hunt Corruptors. He's such a coward that he was afraid I would bite him, so he always squeezed the rope on my collar as tight as it would be.
It seems like every name is a raw scar for Wolverine. Even though he's putting up a calm front, he's clenching his fists tighter and tighter.
But there's no time to be heartbroken over his past. None of the answers have been what you're looking for.
This is the gang leader. He should be the last on the list.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Hm, him... One time near the Rust, we were cornered by Corruptors. It was him who told me to hold the Corruptors back until he could get some weapons here with gang members.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Then, he ordered everyone to drop the unimportant baggage and escaped.
He averts his eyes so that you can't see the emotions in his eyes. But even Pippy realizes how hurt Wolverine feels, and softly whimpers to comfort him.
Unimportant baggage... Did this include Wolverine? You don't have the heart to ask him.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Then I lived by myself along the Rust until these guys came back and asked me to hunt in exchange for meat.

options: Follow up on who's behind the scenes

choices.text: Follow up on who's behind the scenes

steps.content: Did the leader ever take orders from some mysterious character?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: I don't know. I don't think so.

options: Follow up on the source of Mania weapon info

choices.text: Follow up on the source of Mania weapon info

steps.content: Who told them how to make Mania weapons?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: How should I know?

options: Follow up on how Mania weapons are sold

choices.text: Follow up on how Mania weapons are sold

steps.content: They've produced so many weapons. How do they sell them all?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Enough already, this is annoying!

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: It's been a long time since I had anything to do with those bastards!
Wolverine seems ready to leave, and even Pippy starts to show impatience.
Are there really no more leads? Just when you've decided to give up and put away the list, you discover there is one more page stuck at the back.
He looks like a scavenger—why is he on the gang roster?
Wait up. Before you leave, would you take a look at this one last person? He doesn't look like a gangster. He's called Hank...

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Hank?!
As soon as he hears the name, Wolverine grabs the paper from you before you can ask more questions.
Do you know the person in this picture?
Hank... What does he have to do with gangsters and mania weapons?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: What did you say? Hank?!
Hold on, you know the person in the picture?
Wolverine snatches the paper from your hand.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Far more than "knowing". I'll remember him until the day I die!
Wolverine growls the words through clenched teeth. If this man were standing here, Wolverine might rip him apart and devour him.
What's the relationship between you two?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Nothing! He is my enemy! If that old man ever lets me catch sight of him near the Rust, he's dead!

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: He hooks people with smooth words, then turns around and sells them off once he finds he can profit off them.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: I was doing just fine alone in the Rust until he conned me out of it, tricked me into the gang, and then hauled ass with the money!
Hank was the one who got Wolverine stuck in the gang? If he provides toughs for the gang, no wonder he's on the list.
Wolverine mutters angrily, but you can sense a hint of grievance. Seems like he wasn't made into what he is just by the gang. Maybe this attached file will give him some comfort.
test
test
test
test
test
test
test
You should be happy. Your enemy is already dead.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Huh?
Your enemy, Hank, is confirmed dead.
Wolverine's breath catches. He looks at you in a daze, saying nothing. Silence falls in the interrogation room.
Pippy nudges his frozen master, but Wolverine still doesn't react for quite a while.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: He's... dead?
That's right.
He repeats the question, his throat sounding drier than ever.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: That old bastard... is dead?
The report claims so.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: He can't be dead!
Without waiting for you to finish, Wolverine lets out a low growl.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Shouldn't he just take the gang's money and go spend it on booze and meat?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: The old bastard is like a sewer rat, how could he die...
Wolverine opens and closes his mouth a few times, as if he can't quite swallow this new information. Whatever he wants to say, he can't get it out.
Didn't you say he was your enemy? You don't seem happy.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: I am... happy. Of course I'm happy.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content:
But... I never got to beat him up, and he just died...
That old bastard got off too easy...
Even as he says that, the drooping corners of his mouth and strange reaction seem more like sorrow, not the joy of hearing that his enemy got what he deserved.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: No.
But you look...

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: You're wrong.
You both sit in silence, until Wolverine speaks again, hoarsely.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: How did Han... the old bastard die?
The cause of death?
You scan the file, but the only information about Hank is, "The scavenger Hank is confirmed dead." No cause of death, no autopsy report.
It's not recorded, which is strange. I can't believe someone would tamper with it. Maybe it had something to do with the weapon trade...
You close the folder and stand up. Wolverine is still sitting where he was, thinking over what you just said.
That's enough for today. I need time to go to the Rust and search for Hank's residence.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Wait!
He grabs your hand.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: When are you going? I can be your guide.
You want to know how he died, right?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Who cares about that old man! It's... it's because the Rust is too dangerous, and you're an idiot. You'll get lost.
It doesn't seem like he's ready to be honest about the real reason he cares about Hank.
Okay, I can take you along.
I have a dedicated navigation device, I don't need a guide.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: What, you mean one of those electric talking pieces of garbage? That won't help you...
You really want to go?

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: It's not that... I...
Alright, you can go.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Really?
On one condition: you have to promise not to do what you did to those guards today. Please don't hurt people without waiting for an explanation.

steps.speaker: Wolverine
steps.content: Okay...
Wolverine nods hard, and looks less like someone who has any connection to this case than a poor feral kid doing what he has to do to get by.
But what did Hank and Wolverine really have to do with each other? And what was the missing information hiding? You hope that what Hank left behind may hold some clues about the mania weapons.
